messages.author: 198c44d635827adf
messages.subject: Re: Single season occupancy modelling in r
parts:
The tutorial looks good. The only thing I would recommend is using the Royle and Nichols occupancy model because it allows for unaccounted for heterogeneity in detection among sites, which is common with camera trap data.

  Royle, J. A., & Nichols, J. D. (2003). Estimating abundance from repeated presence–absence data or point counts. Ecology, 84(3), 777-790.
